title: jamie-park-optimize-evals-1on1-prep-2026-03-05
content:
Purpose: prep notes for 1:1 with Casey (PM) about the Optimize/evals review. Focus: recent quality regressions flagged by monitoring, prompt-set drift, A/B results for quantized model, and action items for triage and follow-ups.

Quick context (tl;dr):
- Last week monitoring flagged a quality regression on the FAQ prompt-set (precision drop ~5% relative to baseline). Triggered regression alert on 2026-03-01.
- A/B tests for the int8-quantized variant (q4_0) vs baseline float model ran on 20k sessions; preliminary metrics show ~0.8% decrease in semantic-similarity score but ~30% token-cost reduction. Need to evaluate if drop is statistically meaningful for critical prompts.
- Prompt-set coverage: several new user queries (N=120) discovered from customer sandbox that are not well-covered by existing eval prompts.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick sync on regression alert status (5m)
   - show graph: rolling 7d precision/recall for FAQ prompt-set (attach screenshot)
   - current hypothesis (A/B vs recent model bump vs prompt drift)
2) A/B results summary & significance (8m)
   - aggregate metrics: semantic-similarity (cosine) baseline=0.784, q4_0=0.776 (p=0.04), FAQ precision baseline=0.71, q4_0=0.68 (p=0.03)
   - subgroup analysis: FAQ and code-assist prompts show larger gaps; small-chat unaffected
3) Prompt-set hygiene & additions (7m)
   - propose adding 120 new queries from customer-sandbox to realism set; need labeling plan
   - short-term filter to exclude obvious OOD queries from infra tests
4) Next steps & ownership (10m)
   - triage plan, rollback thresholds, monitoring tweaks, and communication to CS/clients

Notes / talking points: 
- Regression severity: moderate; it's above our auto-deploy guardrail (>=3% precision drop on core prompt-sets) but not catastrophic. We should pause any additional model-wide rollouts until triage complete.
- Hypotheses to prioritize:
  * H1: quantization changed token-level scoring on FAQ-style shorter prompts (affects retrieval/answers precision).
  * H2: unlabelled prompt drift — new user patterns not represented in eval set.
  * H3: small change in decoding default (sampling/temperature) got propagated in last infra change.
- Quick experiments to run (priority order):
  1) Re-run A/B restricting to FAQ prompt-set only and compute bootstrap CIs (run job: jira JIRA-OPT-987-A)
  2) Replay requests through float model with same inference settings as quantized variant to confirm quantization impact (reproduce locally + on dedicated infra)
  3) Run ablation: decode param sweep (temp 0.0, 0.2, 0.4) on sample of FAQ prompts to see sensitivity
  4) Add 120 new customer queries to eval holdout and run a quick label-of-3 to estimate impact

Operational decisions I want from Casey: 
- Pause canary? My recommendation: pause further canary growth but keep current canaries running (no rollback yet) until we have the FAQ-only A/B re-run (24–48h).
- Communication: quick note to affected CS accounts (template below) if we confirm measurable drop on customer prompts.

Action items (with owners + rough ETA):
- Jamie: schedule FAQ-only A/B re-run, collect bootstrap stats (ETA: 24h)
- Casey: draft customer-facing communication template + list of affected accounts (ETA: EOD 2026-03-05)
- Aisha: run quantization replay job on dedicated infra (ticket created: JIRA-OPT-988) (ETA: 48h)
- Eng infra (Samir): check last deployment diff for decode defaults and confirm if sampling params changed (ETA: 12h)
- Labeling (Contractors): label 120 new queries (label spec: binary relevance + confidence) — need 3 raters per example (ETA: 72h)

Quick customer note template (draft):
"Hi <Customer>, we observed a small regression on a subset of FAQ-style requests after a recent model variant was introduced. We're actively investigating, running targeted tests, and will follow up within 48 hours with next steps. No immediate action required on your side — we're prioritizing fixes and can revert the variant if we confirm customer impact."

Data pointers / where to look:
- Regression alert dashboard: /console/optimize/alerts/regressions?id=faq-2026-03-01 (link)
- A/B results notebook: github.com/redwood-inference/repro-evals/ab_tests/2026-03-01-q4_vs_float.ipynb
- New queries dump: s3://redwood-optimize/new-queries/2026-03-02/customer-sandbox.csv
- Labeling spec: confluence.company.com/display/OPT/Labeling+Guide+v2

Open questions / risks: 
- If quantization is the driver, do we accept a small quality hit for 30% cost reduction? Need product decision — not purely engineering.
- Are there long-tail prompts where the drop is materially worse (>10%)? Early subgroup looks ok but need thorough run.
- Time to roll back (if we decide to): how quickly can infra revert dedicated pools vs hosted? (ask SRE runbook)

Follow-ups to schedule: 
- 24h follow-up: results from FAQ-only re-run (owner: Jamie)
- 48h: quantization replay + labeling summary (owners: Aisha + Labeling)
- Weekly Optimize sync: raise broader prompt-set coverage plan (owner: Casey)

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- Keep the conversation high-level in 1:1 but get explicit sign-off on pause recommendation.
- Bring up cost tradeoff table (cost delta vs metric delta) — Casey to weigh in.
- If we need to rollback, prep a short runbook with steps and rollback checks (SLOs to re-validate).

End.
